body:
Maria Ops: inbound SFO delivery (12 H100s) 12: AWB SF0-554433. Vendor just reported 1 DOA and 1 serial mismatch at vendor QC. @Jordan can you confirm replacement SLA and whether vendor will pre-provision images?
Jordan SCM: contract says 5 bd replacement. Vendor offered 24h express for +$5,200 USD. Loaner pool?
Li Chen (VendorOps): Vendor confirming AWB SF0-554433 for 10 ship-ready + 2 flagged. Flagged serials: H100-11AA, H100-11AB. We can split-ship replacements tomorrow AM via express (uplift +$5,200). RMA return label: RX-SF0554433. Replacements will be blank (no image flash) unless we request image service (extra).
Alex Crossdock: crossdock: please tag flagged units with `HOLD-QC` and `DOA-UNVERIFIED`. If we don't tag they might get packed. Also customs paperwork updated: vendor changed HTS code on replacement AWB, need importer contact for clearance.
Maria Ops: proposal: partial release 10 -> staging-SFO, hold 2 flagged at crossdock. We have a canary pool depending on 3 of these; risk is moderate. If loaners available for short window, prefer to borrow.
Jordan SCM: loaner pool check: 0 H100 in SFO, 2 in LAX (transit ~6h). LAX -> SFO courier cost 100 and time acceptable for 3-hour window. But 2 flagged = need 2 loaners; we have 2 in LAX but that would leave LAX short. Trade-off: pay vendor $5.2k for express replacements or move 2 from LAX and accept regional shortage. Decision?
Nina SRE: canary note: we can stagger canary to run with 9 H100 temporarily but will delay rollout by 6h. Prefer minimal customer impact -> loaners if transit <8h.
Maria Ops: finance call: express might be faster but check cost. @finance-bot please advise quick. Also vendor: request confirmed HTS and importer name on replacement AWB to avoid customs hold.
finance-bot: finance-bot: expedited replacement ($5,200) < potential customer SLA credits. Approve up to $6,000 USD for express replacements. Charge center: INFRA-GPU-SFO. Please attach vendor invoice to expense ticket.
Li Chen (VendorOps): acknowledged. Scheduling express pickup now; expected to post tracking: 1775552540. ETA depot SFO: 24-36h. Sending replacement AWB SF0-554433-R and confirmed HTS/Importer in separate email. Prepaid RMA label RX-SF0554433 included.
Alex Crossdock: applying tags and moving 10 units to `staging-sfo-ready`. Will not ship the 2 flagged units. Crossdock asks vendor to confirm importer EIN on replacement AWB to avoid customs.
Jordan SCM: opting to accept vendor express (finance approved). We'll NOT pull loaners to avoid LAX shortage. Jordan: please confirm vendor will do CRS wipe/flash if we pay extra or we handle internally.
Li Chen (VendorOps): vendor can offer image flash service for +$650 per unit. If you want that, we'll add to invoice. Otherwise units delivered blank.
Maria Ops: we will image in-house. Proceed with express replacements only. Manifest snippet pushed into staging system:
```
unit,serial,location,status
H100,H100-1101,staging-sfo,ready
H100,H100-1102,staging-sfo,ready
...
H100,H100-11AA,crossdock-sfo,hold-qc-doa
H100,H100-11AB,crossdock-sfo,hold-serial-mismatch
```
Maria Ops: crossdock instructed. Nina SRE will delay canary by 6h. Closing thread unless vendor misses ETA or customs holds replacement. (Maria Ops reaction: :white_check_mark:)
